items.html: It thus follows that the kings that remained unsorted are themselves the vitality of the shells. And because they are there, they are called “the public domain,” since they are separated and not joined, for they have not yet been corrected. And they are the “eleven days from Horeb by way of Mount Seir” — they are the kings who reigned in Mount Seir, which is Edom. And they are those of whom it was said, “Where is their god, the rock in whom they trusted?” — which corresponds to the number eleven. And they are the eleven spices of the incense, which, when they are burned, rise upward and depart from among the dross called death; and then the dross and the death are nullified, and “the plague was stayed.” And understand this.
